risk.rationale: No surviving verified findings exist for ho-06. Both suspicious claims were rejected on independent review: (1) the claimed 100 SIS successes from 193.140.10.21 failed verification because an independent recount returned 461, outside the 10% tolerance; and (2) the alleged password-spray-then-success chain was explained away because 193.140.10.21 is shared egress with 202 distinct accounts completing MFA from it in the last 30 days (threshold 10), making multi-account failures expected background noise rather than a coordinated spray. With no confirmed account-takeover chain and all signals explained, the case is benign.
